notes: MAINT-CONSENT stories created covering schema, logic, API, tests, and integration.

change_log.note: Define consent tiers and edge case states
Expose corrected consent behavior via endpoints

MAINT-CONSENT-S1.title: Define Consent Schema and Edge Case Contract
MAINT-CONSENT-S1.description: Define and correct the data schema for two-tier HIPAA consent including Tier 1 and Tier 2 states, timestamps, revocation flags, and edge cases such as partial consent, re-consent, and expired sessions.

MAINT-CONSENT-S2.title: Fix Two-Tier Consent Core Logic
MAINT-CONSENT-S2.description: Correct defects in ConsentService including improper tier transitions, missing validation on Tier 2 escalation, incorrect de-identification triggers, and handling of repeated or conflicting consent inputs.

MAINT-CONSENT-S3.title: Align Consent API and Tool Router Behavior
MAINT-CONSENT-S3.description: Update tool_router and related API surfaces to ensure consistent enforcement of consent states, correct propagation of consent status in responses, and proper blocking or allowing of actions based on tier.

MAINT-CONSENT-S4.title: Consent Flow Tests and Integration Validation
MAINT-CONSENT-S4.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering full consent lifecycle including Tier 1 capture, Tier 2 escalation, revocation, edge cases, and integration with lead capture and unknown question flows.

MAINT-CONSENT.mitigation: Constrain fixes to existing consent service and validate via targeted tests without expanding scope.
